verification.verification_method: Public commit archive downloaded and every tracked file compared byte for byte.
verification.scope: Exact artifact content commit verified on public main. A subsequent envelope commit adds the review archive, current manifests and publication records; deck and synthetic dataset bytes are unchanged.

scope: This record anchors the immutable deck content. The final review envelope is a subsequent commit; its ZIP hash is in the separate checksum file to avoid a self-referential archive hash.
